```python
"""
Return Deadline Reminder Script
Calculates the last day to return items based on a 30-day return window.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# === Configuration ===
ORDER_ID = "ORD-5B048F"
ORDER_DATE = "2026-09-02"  # Actual order date (YYYY-MM-DD)
RETURN_WINDOW_DAYS = 30
ITEMS = [
    "Anker Portable Bluetooth Speaker",
    "LogiTech Wireless Mouse M310",
]

def main():
    today = datetime.now().date()
    order_date = datetime.strptime(ORDER_DATE, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
    return_deadline = order_date + timedelta(days=RETURN_WINDOW_DAYS)
    days_remaining = (return_deadline - today).days

    print("=" * 50)
    print(f"  🛒 Return Deadline Reminder")
    print("=" * 50)
    print(f"  Order ID:        {ORDER_ID}")
    print(f"  Order Date:      {order_date.strftime('%B %d, %Y')}")
    print(f"  Return Deadline: {return_deadline.strftime('%B %d, %Y')}")
    print(f"  Items:")
    for item in ITEMS:
        print(f"    - {item}")
    print("-" * 50)

    if days_remaining < 0:
        print(f"  ❌ Return window EXPIRED {abs(days_remaining)} day(s) ago!")
    elif days_remaining == 0:
        print(f"  ⚠️  TODAY is the LAST DAY to return your items!")
    elif days_remaining <= 7:
        print(f"  ⚠️  URGENT: Only {days_remaining} day(s) left to return!")
    else:
        print(f"  ✅ You have {days_remaining} day(s) left to return.")

    print("=" * 50)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
